final_text:
Added an order history/cancellation flow.

What changed:
- Added a cancel-order API: `PATCH /api/orders/:id/cancel`
  - Only allows cancellation before the order is sent
  - Prevents cancelling sent/shipped/delivered/cancelled orders
  - Restores product stock when an order is cancelled
- Updated order history UI:
  - Shows better status badges
  - Adds a visible “Cancel Order” button for cancelable orders
  - Updates the order status after cancellation
- Added support in the database layer for the `orders.status` field if it’s missing
- Kept the existing order history page and extended it rather than creating a separate route/page shell

Note:
- I wasn’t able to fully run TypeScript linting in this container because `tsc` isn’t available here.
